sloka: इति एवम् उक्त्वा ते सर्वे ययुः देवा यथा आगतम्।ततो राज ऋषयः सर्वे सम्गताः परम ऋषयः ॥३-३०-३३॥
transliteration: iti evam uktvā te sarve yayuḥ devā yathā āgatam।tato rāja ṛṣayaḥ sarve samgatāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ ॥3-30-33॥

translations.english: Meanwhile the wonderstruck gods along with the charanas (celestial bards) got together and began beating the drums and raining showers of flowers on Rama from all sides.
